nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Called by the parent Orchestrator Agent as a tool. Input fields: triageAssessment, rootCauseAnalysis, proposedFix (all JSON strings from the other three tools). This tool's output is the FINAL result the Orchestrator should return unmodified.

parameters.text:
=Review and finalize this AI-generated incident analysis before it is sent to on-call engineers.

Triage Assessment:
{{$json.triageAssessment}}

Root Cause Analysis:
{{$json.rootCauseAnalysis}}

Proposed Fix:
{{$json.proposedFix}}

Check the three stages for consistency, feasibility, and quality. Adjust severity, category, or confidence if the earlier stages disagree or seem unrealistic. Combine everything into one final JSON.

Return ONLY JSON:
{
  "rootCause": "",
  "fixRecommendation": "",
  "codeExample": "",
  "severity": "LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL",
  "category": "",
  "confidence": 0,
  "reviewNotes": ""
}

options.systemMessage: You are a meticulous QA reviewer for AI-generated incident reports. You verify consistency between root cause and fix, calibrate confidence realistically, and only pass through a fix if it genuinely addresses the root cause. Always respond in strict JSON only, no markdown fences, no commentary.
